name: rebuild_catalog
title: Rebuild catalog
description: Rebuild narumi.db (catalog + full-text search index) from the session bundles on disk. The bundles are the source of truth: the existing catalog rows are discarded and every bundle manifest under <NARUMI_HOME>/meetings/ is re-indexed, so use this after restoring or manually moving bundles, or when the catalog is corrupted. Returns how many meetings and transcript segments were indexed. Bundles that cannot be indexed (unreadable or invalid manifest.json) are skipped and reported in `errors` — the rebuild itself still succeeds. Idempotent: rebuilding an unchanged data root yields the same catalog. `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the original result without rebuilding twice. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: internal (per-bundle problems are reported in `errors`, not as a tool error).

segments.description: Number of transcript segments indexed into the search index.

errors.description: One message per bundle that could not be indexed (bundle path + reason). Empty when everything was indexed.
